learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will understand how adverbs modify verbs, adjectives, and other adverbs, and successfully identify Adverbs of Manner, Time, and Place.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 You know that adjectives describe nouns, but who describes the actions? Enter Adverbs! They are the directors of the sentence, telling us exactly *how*, *when*, or *where* an action happens. Let's add some action details!

lesson_modules.module_title: 🏃 What is an Adverb? (क्रिया विशेषण क्या है?)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: An adverb is a word that adds more meaning to a Verb, an Adjective, or even another Adverb. Many adverbs are formed by adding '-ly' to an adjective (like sweet -> sweetly), but not all of them!
examples_or_templates: Modifying an Adjective: She is **very** beautiful.
Modifying an Adverb: He speaks **quite** loudly.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Adverbs of Manner tell us *HOW* an action is done. They usually come right after the main verb or after the object.

lesson_modules.module_title: ⏰📍 Adverbs of Time and Place (कालवाचक और स्थानवाचक)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Adverbs of Time tell us *WHEN* an action takes place (now, yesterday, later). Adverbs of Place tell us *WHERE* an action happens (here, there, outside, inside).
examples_or_templates: Time: I will complete my homework **tomorrow**.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which word is the adverb in this sentence: 'The old man walked slowly.'?
❓ What type of adverb is the word 'Yesterday'?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Turn this Adjective into an Adverb of Manner: 'Quiet'.
subjective_practice.hint: Just add '-ly' to the end of the word!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Underline the Adverb of Place in this sentence: 'Look up, the airplane is flying high!'
✍️ Write a sentence about a turtle using the adverb 'slowly'.
subjective_practice.hint: What action does a turtle do slowly?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎬 Simon Says... with Adverbs!
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Play a game with your family where you give commands using adverbs of manner. For example: 'Simon says touch your nose QUICKLY', or 'Simon says walk around the room SILENTLY'. Anyone who does it wrong is out!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Adverbs add more information to verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
⭐ Adverbs of Manner answer the question 'How?'.
⭐ Adverbs of Time answer 'When?', and Adverbs of Place answer 'Where?'.
